chapter: Teaching, radio and the WSMB band
title: WSMB band on salary under Roosevelt rules
summary: Radio station rules had the station hire six musicians until the Taft-Hartley law ended the band.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Was the band on salary during that time that you had? Yeah, yeah, yeah.

Yeah, we were under the wing of Franklin Roosevelt at that time. Franklin Roosevelt had various rules, you know, if a radio station made a certain amount of money, they were going to have to hire a certain number of men. Well, WSMB made enough money to hire six men, so they had to hire six men. What the heck, it wasn't any skin off of that pocketbook. No. Lord have mercy, they had to give it to the government in income tax anyway. It's ridiculous. Well, as soon as the Taft-Hartley law was passed, they canned us. Yes, sir, take your notice.
